[Urda Town Square Center]
On this site, a fierce battle for control of the great city was waged, and on this site is where its citizens now celebrate that victory. Statues of the fallen heroes, and great leaders of the alliance adorn the tops of grand marble archways that scatter over the square. They stand ever vigilant against any unseen enemy. The people of Urda flock here to barter and trade, to converse with friends, or just relax near the fountain and have a game of chess. Benches and tables dot the landscape near the edge of the fountain. Hawkers of all type roll through this area with their wares, hoping to make a few coins. The many languages of races and guilds reverberate off the storefronts of the surrounding Merchant Square where a constant foot traffic ebbs and flows, making this the heart of the city.

[Twisted Head Priest's Office]

The rest of the room seems bare except for smoking torches hung around the walls. Like the candles in the portal room, the flames miraculously burn downward. Overhead a large oak desk hanging upside-down, hopefully nailed securely in place. Papers are scattered across its surface, and an inkwell sits uncorked with a feather quill sitting nearby, it seems as if gravity has no hold over the desk or anything else on the ceiling, including a rug that is an exact color inverted copy of the rug from the Priest's office. A faint breeze emanates from the portal, scattering loose papers across the oak desk, some of the fragile papers blow off the surface and fall upward toward the roof.

[Twisted Cathedral East Wing]
The floor arches downward toward the center of the massive cathedral and the lining it tiles are scuffed and scraped, but it is more intact than the ceiling in the above room. It is a scene of the open sky. A massive bird, its wings outstretched, takes up the center of the mosaic. In its beak it holds a twisting knot made of sun-bleached rowan wood. The image of the bird on the true cathedral's ceiling would likely be white if it was still intact, but here it is black. Its feathers look almost like scales in the flickering torchlight, and for just a moment, the image of the bird is replaced by a sight of a terrifying black scaled dragon, its yellowed talons reaching for the unwary adventurer.

The area is illuminated.

Drying streaks of blood stain the tiled floor, and ominous knives and hooks hang from the stone walls.

[Twisted Cathedral East Wing]
The floor arches downward toward the center of the massive cathedral and the lining it tiles are scuffed and scraped, but it is more intact than the ceiling in the above room. [Twisted Cathedral East Wing]
The floor arches downward toward the center of the massive cathedral and the lining it tiles are scuffed and scraped, but it is more intact than the ceiling in the above room. It is a scene of the open sky. A massive bird, its wings outstretched, takes up the center of the mosaic. In its beak it holds a twisting knot made of sun-bleached rowan wood. [Twisted Cathedral East Wing]
The floor arches downward toward the center of the massive cathedral and the lining it tiles are scuffed and scraped, but it is more intact than the ceiling in the above room. It is a scene of the open sky. A massive bird, its wings outstretched, takes up the center of the mosaic. In its beak it holds a twisting knot made of sun-bleached rowan wood. The image of the bird on the true cathedral's ceiling would likely be white if it was still intact, but here it is black. Its feathers look almost like scales in the flickering torchlight, and for just a moment, the image of the bird is replaced by a sight of a terrifying black scaled dragon, its yellowed talons reaching for the unwary adventurer.

[Twisted Cathedral East Wing]
The floor arches downward toward the center of the massive cathedral and the lining it tiles are scuffed and scraped, but it is more intact than the ceiling in the above room. It is a scene of the open sky. A massive bird, its wings outstretched, takes up the center of the mosaic. In its beak it holds a twisting knot made of sun-bleached rowan wood. The image of the bird on the true cathedral's ceiling would likely be white if it was still intact, but here it is black. Its feathers look almost like scales in the flickering torchlight, and for just a moment, the image of the bird is replaced by a sight of a terrifying black scaled dragon, its yellowed talons reaching for the unwary adventurer.

The area is illuminated.
